meta.title: Vita Language
meta.description: Online classes for Spanish conversation, Spanish school exams, Korean conversation and TOPIK

home.heroQuestion: How many sentences did you say today
home.heroLead: Learn from lessons, check yourself with practice sets, and speak in 15-minute calls. Online classes in Spanish and Korean, built around time spent speaking.
home.coursesLead: Pick a course by the language you are learning and what you need it for.
home.pricingLead: Every plan includes lessons, practice sets and Q&A. Higher plans add live classes and speaking calls.
home.instructorBody: The same instructor makes the lessons, grades your answers, runs your calls and replies on the Q&A board. Questions from class carry over into your next call.
home.boardBody: Check notices for schedules and changes. Enrolled students can post questions on their course Q&A board.

features.a: Watch your course videos as often as you like while enrolled. Mark each lesson done to track progress.

features.q: How do I check my level?
features.a: Practice sets and timed mock exams. Multiple choice and short answers are graded instantly. Written answers are graded by the instructor.
Book a 15-minute 1:1 speaking call from the calendar. A Google Meet link is created when you book.
Yes, on Google Meet at scheduled times. The join link opens 30 minutes before the start.
Post on your course Q&A board and the instructor replies. You can also post private questions only you and the instructor can see.
The My Class calendar shows your booked calls and live classes on one screen.

pricing.title: Plans
pricing.lead: We are in a test run and do not take online payments yet. Send an application and the instructor will open your access after checking it.
pricing.note: Prices and plan contents will be set at the official launch.

apply.title: Apply
apply.lead: Choose a course and plan, and add a note. Once the instructor approves, the course appears in My Class.
apply.messagePlaceholder: Your current level, school year, preferred schedule, and so on.
apply.sent: Application sent. The course will appear in My Class once approved.
apply.error: Could not send your application. Try again in a moment.
apply.noRequests: You have not sent any applications yet.

login.title: Log in
login.lead: New here? Logging in creates your account. You can start once the instructor approves it.
login.emailSent: We sent a login link to {email}. Open it from your inbox.
login.sameBrowser: Open the link in this browser to log in. If you open it on another device or app, request a new link.
login.invalidEmail: Check the email address and try again.
login.other_device: You logged in on another device, so this device was logged out. Each account works on one device at a time.
login.notConfigured: The login server is not connected yet. Contact the administrator.
login.policy: Each account can be logged in on one device at a time. Logging in on a new device logs out the previous one.

live.title: Live and calls
live.lead: Live classes run on Google Meet at scheduled times. Speaking calls are 15-minute 1:1 sessions at a time you choose.
live.liveHowBody: Schedules are visible to Standard and Premium students. The join link opens 30 minutes before the start.
live.callHowBody: Each plan includes a set number of calls per month. Book and check your schedule in My Class.
live.loginToSee: Log in to see live classes for your courses.

board.title: Notices and Q&A
board.qaLocked: Q&A is for enrolled students. Log in to see the boards for your courses.
board.emptyQa: No questions yet. Ask the first one.
board.private: Private (only you and the instructor can see it)
board.noAccess: You do not have access to this post.
board.error: Could not save. Check what you entered.
board.deleteConfirm: This cannot be undone. Delete it?
